name: Cadillac

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation for sweet white wine, in the Entre-Deux-Mers area. It is made from Sémillon, Sauvignon, Sauvignon Gris and Muscadelle, and takes its name from the town of Cadillac-sur-Garonne.
